sam: Quick post-all-hands Q: can we get a one-paragraph summary of how regional autoscale favoring works? Customers asked for a short explainer.

maya: Short answer: try local, then continent, then global. We use a weighted score (demand, idle, tier) + stabilization to avoid flip-flop.

oliver: Stabilization = evaluation window + cooldown, right? What's default?

maya: Defaults: eval_window=90s, cooldown=180s, hysteresis=10%. Adjustable in policy per-customer.

gina: If multiple regions report low idle, how do we pick donors?
maya: We rank donors by weight and also apply a per-donor cap to protect resident SLOs. Donor selection avoids moving everything at once.

sam: Any visible signal for customers when spill happens?
maya: Yes, hosted responses include headers: `x-redwood-fallback-region` and `x-redwood-fallback-reason`. Private deploys opt-in.

oliver: Procurements update? Heard APAC racks slipped. Impact to policies?
gina: APAC rack ETA slipped ~3 weeks; we temporarily bump same-continent weight for APAC to reduce global egress.

infra-bot: Note: donor pressure spike detected 2026-03-11T05:02Z, automated throttles engaged. See INC-2026-277.

sam: Thanks. Can someone drop a 2-paragraph FAQ + a small diagram into the all-hands followups doc? That'll help CS.
maya: Will add policy snippet and FAQ by EOD.
